about_the_game:
VR Overlay System brings quality of life to PCVR users and pro content creators!

With a special focus on the needs of social VR creators, we put everything you need to have a better VR experience in one cohesive system.

From playspace moving, to osc messaging, to avatar updates and a variety of stream tools.

No more clicking through to the OS past multiple compositor layers to get things done.

Highly resilient system that will never experience a Unity runtime crash that brings down your OS because of a crashed window capture.

We've built a complete overlay application framework from scratch with maximum focus on the needs of real users, maximizing stability and long-running systems, allowing users to seamlessly swap between desktop mode and VR without a hitch.

build by VR gamers, for VR gamers!

Early Access & playtest support is handled in discord for quickest response time!
